title: Russia mocks Latvian PM Evika Siliņa's resignation as 'Zelensky curse'
desc: Latvian Prime Minister Evika Siliņa resigned after a coalition collapse triggered by fallout from stray Ukrainian drones that exploded at a Latvian oil facility. Russia mocked the crisis as the “Zelensky curse” while Latvia faces political instability and coalition negotiations.

title: Fatima Sana's record blitz powers Pakistan to clean sweep over Zimbabwe
desc: Sana smashed the fastest half-century in Women's T20 International history, reaching the milestone in just 15 balls during her explosive, unbeaten knock. The Pakistan skipper hammered 10 boundaries and two sixes in her 62 not out off just 19 balls to rewrite the record books.

title: American burger chains struggle to adapt in Vietnam's price-sensitive market
desc: HANOI: American-style burger chains are finding Vietnam a far tougher market than expected, as local diners continue to favour familiar flavours, affordable meals and eating habits deeply rooted in rice, noodles and street food culture.

title: Six ways to maximise nutritional benefits of locust beans
desc: There is something unmistakable about the smell of locust beans. You either fall in love with it instantly or learn to appreciate it over time. But beyond its strong, signature aroma, this humble kitchen staple, popularly known as iru, is quietly one of the most nutritious ingredients sitting in many Nigerian kitchens.
